label: Bible Study
prompt: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. _____ is of the LORD.
verse: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.
note: Jonah's prayer from inside the fish ends here — and the very next verse, he's back on dry land.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy _____, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verse: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
note: Faith passed on at home: talk of God's words sitting, walking, lying down and rising up.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one _____ in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verse: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
note: Matthew applies Isaiah's 'voice of one crying in the wilderness' to John the Baptist, the road crew for the coming King.

label: Deep Water
prompt: With him is an _____ of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
verse: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
note: Hezekiah sizes up Assyria for his people: their side has an arm of flesh, ours has God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For the love of Christ _____ us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verse: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
note: 'The love of Christ constraineth us' — hems us in and drives us on. Paul's motive for everything.
